note: Spoken replies used by voice_turn. Pidgin wording is unreviewed; yo, ha and ig fall back to English until native speakers write them.

read_back.en: Let me read it back to you.
read_back.pcm: Make I read am back give you.

which_one.en: Which one? Please choose from the options.
which_one.pcm: Which one? Abeg choose from the options.

repeat.en: Sorry, I did not catch that. Please say it again.
repeat.pcm: Sorry, I no hear you well. Abeg talk am again.

ask_recipient.en: Who should I send it to?
ask_recipient.pcm: Na who you wan send am give?

ask_amount_again.en: I want to be sure of the amount. Please say it again, or type it.
ask_amount_again.pcm: I wan sure of the amount. Abeg talk am again, or type am.

ask_intent.en: I can send money or check your balance. What would you like?
ask_intent.pcm: I fit send money or check your balance. Wetin you want?

not_found.en: I could not find that person. Please choose from your saved recipients.
not_found.pcm: I no see that person. Abeg choose from your saved people.

handoff_amount.en: Please type the amount on your keypad.
handoff_amount.pcm: Abeg type the amount for your keypad.

handoff_recipient.en: Please pick the recipient from your list.
handoff_recipient.pcm: Abeg pick the person from your list.

handoff_type.en: I could not hear you well. Please type it instead.
handoff_type.pcm: I no hear well. Abeg type am instead.

handoff_form.en: Let us do this with the form.
handoff_form.pcm: Make we use the form do am.

unavailable.en: Voice is not available right now. Please type instead.
unavailable.pcm: Voice no dey work now. Abeg type am.
